title: VehicularCabinTelemetryFrame
description: Schema for cabin telemetry. Unified Sensirion SCD30 is required; sensor_profile, alerts, dht22, and actuator_state are optional.

car_id.description: Unique vehicle identifier within the fleet namespace.

timestamp_unix_s.description: Hardware-sampled Unix epoch timestamp in seconds.

sensor_profile.description: Identifies whether telemetry uses only the unified SCD30 or legacy dual SCD30+DHT22.

co2_ppm.description: Carbon dioxide concentration measured by NDIR optical spectroscopy.

temperature_c.description: Cabin dry-bulb temperature from SCD30 transducer.

co2.description: True when SCD30 CO2 is at or above 800 ppm.

temperature.description: True when SCD30 temperature is outside [18, 30] C.

humidity.description: True when SCD30 relative humidity is outside [30, 60] %.

temperature_c.description: Legacy redundant cabin dry-bulb temperature from capacitive/NTC transducer.

humidity_pct.description: Legacy redundant relative humidity from DHT22.

pwm_duty_pct.description: Current commanded actuator PWM duty cycle percentage, modulating the Blue purge LED actuator intensity in the MVP.

tachometer_rpm.description: Observed actuator rotational speed or bench emulation pulse rate measured via PCNT sensor.

carrier_freq_hz.description: Carrier switching frequency of the actuator LEDC timer in Hertz.
